findings.description: Aliasing sync-ralph-state to sync-roadmap-state mislabels the watcher-derived STATUS/pipeline-state sync as 'roadmap', contradicting the plan's own two-part glossary (status != roadmap).
findings.resolution: Dropped the sync-roadmap-state/:watch aliases entirely. sync-ralph-state stays unchanged (already carries no 'overview'); only roadmap/roadmap:dev/roadmap:build/roadmap:build:preview alias the overview* keys. Updated Files, US-003, In-Scope, and the npm AC.

findings.description: The 'preserve generic ## Overview headings' rule is too blunt; AGENTS.md ## Overview data — two-file split is a SYSTEM reference and a legitimate rename target. An impl agent could wrongly skip it.
findings.resolution: Clarified the test is the REFERENT not the ## form; explicitly named AGENTS.md ## Overview data as a rename target and added it to the living-docs AC.

findings.description: AC referenced overview.parallel_ready_tasks (internal registration key) rather than the consumer-facing tool id mcp__ralph-overview__overview_parallel_ready_tasks.
findings.resolution: AC now uses the full consumer-facing tool id and notes the dot form is the internal registration key.

findings.description: Version-bump scope incomplete: only .claude-plugin/plugin.json named, but plugin AGENTS.md:184-187 requires marketplace + manifest versions in sync (.codex-plugin/plugin.json, .github/plugin/plugin.json, and 3 marketplace.json indexes).
findings.resolution: Expanded the version-bump bullet + US-007 to enumerate all manifests + 3 marketplace indexes and cite the plugin's own ceremony; added a version-sync AC requiring all to equal the bumped value + the codexu table.

findings.sectionRef: Optional additive technical aliases / US-004, US-006
findings.description: Optional-alias integration points under-specified: codexu bin/ralph-overview.mjs is GENERATED from templates/consumer-ralph-overview.mjs (so the env dual-read must edit the template + regen, not hand-edit), and MCP dual-register spans 11 registrations across 7 files (init.ts, validate-data.ts, parallel-ready-tasks.ts, expand-task-context.ts, unblock-candidates.ts, data-write.ts, server.ts) + stdio-tools-list tests, not just data-write.ts.
findings.resolution: Reworked US-004 to a template edit (+ test) + codexu wrapper regen; corrected the bin/ralph-overview.mjs bullet to forbid hand-edits. Expanded US-006/Files to list all 11 MCP registration files + tests/skills/docs and marked it all-or-nothing with a DEFER recommendation.

findings.description: Viewer surface list misses strings + tests: TopLevelSurfaces.tsx:56,60,62,64 (not only 108-109), overview.html:9 'Loading overview data…', PipelineOverview.tsx:26,35 aria-label, and the asserting tests devServerHtml.test.ts:14,17 + pipelineOverview.test.tsx:52.
findings.resolution: Added all missing strings + the two test files to the viewer Files list, US-005, the sidecar exclusiveFiles, and a viewer-test-suite AC; added the rg discovery command.

findings.description: Plan narrows D-001's literal ~1,880-occurrence prose sweep to living-docs-only while claiming to inherit D-001, leaving acceptance underspecified and the deviation implicit.
findings.resolution: Made the narrowing EXPLICIT in In-Scope as a 'living-docs-first' interpretation and sharpened Q6 to require operator sign-off (approve living-docs-first vs. full D-001 sweep). This is a flagged decision, not a silent inheritance.

findings.description: Key ACs were reviewer-judgment / history-order dependent ('present BEFORE any rename', 'reviewer confirms nothing technical renamed') and not auto-verifiable from one final commit.
findings.resolution: Replaced with auto-verifiable grep ACs (no new .ralph-roadmap/mcp__ralph-roadmap/ralph-roadmap/bin/ralph-roadmap; files overview.html + bin/ralph-overview.mjs intact; old overview* scripts remain; .crews/** has no roadmap-bookkeeper unless Q2 approved) and encoded define-first as a separate ordered story.

findings.description: Cross-repo order contradictory: Overview said submodule-first then codexu pointer bump, but Files labeled codexu 'commit set #1' / toolkit '#2' and phases ran codexu-surface (phase 1) before toolkit-surface (phase 2).
findings.resolution: Separated codexu docs/scripts surface (independent) from the codexu pointer/version-table ship. Toolkit lands first (phase 1, parallel with codexu-surface); ship-coordination (phase 2) depends on both. Updated Overview, Files headers, decomposition prose, and the JSON sidecar; encoded the ralph-overview-create-task-skill serialization as a ship dependency.

findings.sectionRef: Files / US-007 / Suggested Decomposition / JSON sidecar (round 2)
findings.description: Round-2: version/table ownership still split — the active-plugin-versions table update appeared in the codexu-surface AGENTS.md bullet, and the version bump was claimed by BOTH toolkit-surface (Files) and ship-coordination (US-007 + JSON sharedFiles).
findings.resolution: Single-sourced ownership: toolkit-surface OWNS the plugin version bump (CHANGELOG + 3 manifests + 3 marketplace indexes) as its final ship step; ship-coordination owns ONLY the codexu submodule pointer + codexu AGENTS.md table (set to that value). Removed the table clause from the codexu-surface AGENTS.md bullet; reworded US-007; updated the decomposition prose + JSON exclusiveFiles accordingly.

findings.description: Round-2: optional US-004 codexu wrapper regen was described in prose but not formally owned in the JSON sidecar (ship-coordination.stories was [US-007] and omitted bin/ralph-overview.mjs), so a sidecar-following impl agent could miss the generated wrapper update if Q4 landed.
findings.resolution: Added US-004 to ship-coordination.stories and bin/ralph-overview.mjs to its exclusiveFiles, with a rationale noting US-004 is one optional feature split across toolkit-surface (template edit) and ship-coordination (codexu wrapper regen). reviewer-claude returned 'No issues found' on the same round-2 re-review.
